answer: Web3Geeks offers a full refund within 7 days of purchase if no deliverable has been started, and a partial (50%) refund within 14 days if work has begun but not been delivered. After 14 days or after final delivery, refunds are not issued automatically and require manager approval.

For smart contract bugs, ask the client for the contract address, network (mainnet/testnet), transaction hash, and a description of expected vs actual behavior. Route to the Solidity dev pod. Do not advise on security-critical fixes without an audit.
New client onboarding requires: signed SOW, deposit invoice paid, access to relevant repos/Figma/Notion, and a kickoff call scheduled within 5 business days. Send the onboarding checklist template.
Standard delivery timelines: landing page 5-7 business days, full dApp MVP 3-5 weeks, smart contract audit add-on 1-2 weeks. Delays are communicated proactively 48 hours before a missed milestone.

For billing disputes, pull the invoice ID and payment processor transaction ID. Discrepancies under $50 can be auto-credited by support. Disputes over $50 require finance team + manager sign-off before any credit or refund is issued.
Contract cancellations always require manager approval regardless of stage, since they affect active resourcing and potential penalty clauses in the SOW.
